command: set -euo pipefail; adb start-server >/dev/null; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo DEVICE_MODEL=$MODEL; case "$MODEL" in SM-S906*) ;; *) echo UNEXPECTED_DEVICE_MODEL >&2; exit 20;; esac; adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP; sleep 2; adb shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/tmp/tracker-v3-monkey.txt 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/tracker-v3-monkey.txt; exit 21; }; sleep 3; if ! adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; then adb shell input tap 503 159; sleep 6; fi; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'isForeground=true'; snapshot_count(){ D="$1"; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$D/tracker_database"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-wal > "$D/tracker_database-wal" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-wal"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-shm > "$D/tracker_database-shm" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-shm"; sqlite3 "$D/tracker_database" 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_samples;'; }; C1=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v3-on1 | tail -n1); sleep 10; C2=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v3-on2 | tail -n1); echo SCREEN_ON_COUNTS=$C1,$C2; test "$C2" -gt "$C1" || { echo INCONCLUSIVE_NO_SCREEN_ON_RF_GROWTH >&2; exit 31; }; echo SCREEN_ON_RF_GROWTH_PASS
